xsmall.$description: Kbd, tiny chips, a mark of a map. The smallest step.

small.$description: Count chips, the checkbox, skeleton lines, inline hit targets.

medium.$description: Buttons, inputs, chips, tooltips, menu items. The scale's base.

large.$description: Cards, popovers, hover cards, menus and listboxes.

xlarge.$description: A surface that holds cards: the Tray. Between a card and a dialog; a sheet runs flush to the window's edge, and a dialog is xxlarge.

xxlarge.$description: Dialogs, the command palette, a drawer's free edge, spotlight cards.

selected.$description: The width used to indicate a selected element, such as an active tab or a chosen item.

focused.$description: The width used for the focus ring on interactive elements.

default.$description: The default width for all standard component borders and dividers.
